title: The Barterer Mod
description: Ever found yourself with stacks and stacks of useless junk? Why not sell it to the barterer for a bit of profit?
body:
Introducing **the Barterer**: a new entity summoned using the new **Barter Bell** block. He accepts all the junk you have, just give it to him and get some emeralds in return; jst don't hit him, he gets scared easily.

When you try to summon the Barterer, the Barter Bell will first generate a little square for him to find after 5 minutes; but if you just want to use the bell as decoration without the fear of destroying your build, right-click it with the new **Bell Calibrator**, which will deactivate it (right-click again to reactivate).
